A: Use a direct model invocation in the API; an agent adds no value for supplied-text summarization.
B: Evaluate Model Router for dynamic model selection and make the cost-quality tradeoff measurable before pinning a premium model.
C: Start with a Prompt Agent because instructions and supported tools are declarative; avoid a custom runtime before considering a Hosted Agent.
D: The custom dependencies and orchestration justify evaluating a Hosted Agent implemented with Microsoft Agent Framework.
E: Evaluate Foundry IQ before custom RAG so enterprise permissions and organizational knowledge stay governed.
F: Create a shared Toolbox as the centralized reusable capability instead of duplicating each tool definition.
G: Create a reusable Foundry Skill and avoid duplicating the shared procedure across agents.
H: Do not assume the region from memory. Use authenticated live discovery against the subscription and separately verify regional availability, compatibility, quota and capacity.
I: Evaluate Foundry Local for on-device local inference that continues offline without network connectivity.
J: Five agents are unnecessary complexity. A single direct model invocation is the simplest architecture for summarizing one paragraph.
